test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".

A witness had seen a youth, / perhaps aged young as/ ten or eleven, acting suspiciously.

options.text: A witness had seen a youth,

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment in the sentence which contains a** grammatical error** is: *'perhaps aged young as'*
 
• The** correct phrase should be** "perhaps as young as" instead of "perhaps aged young as".
 
• This is a common **phrase used to **estimate someone's age.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** would be: *"A witness had seen a youth, perhaps as young as ten or eleven, acting suspiciously."*
